rules.label: Full Charity Discount (0-250% FPL)
rules.quote: Federal Poverty Levels based on total household income, with sufficient supporting documentation provided by the patient, will have a 100% Charity discount processed.

rules.label: Partial Charity Discount (251-400% FPL)
rules.quote: For patients whose documented income is between 251 and 400 percent of the Federal Poverty Level, we have an expanded financial assistance policy that may reduce the amount you owe.

rules.label: Uninsured Discount
rules.quote: All Self-Pay patients, excluding elective cosmetic procedures and facility designated self-pay flat rate procedures , will receive discount similar to managed care, referred to as an "uninsured discount".

payment_plan.quote: You do not owe any more money after: You make 36 monthly payments, or You pay the full discounted amount in your payment plan.

notes: The policy mentions that some locations may have additional criteria for charity eligibility beyond FPL (e.g., high medical costs, more lenient income levels).
Medicare accounts and non-Medicare inpatient accounts require supporting income verification documentation.
The uninsured discount excludes elective cosmetic procedures and facility designated self-pay flat rate procedures.
Patients must apply for Medicaid or other public programs; charity discount cannot be applied if any outstanding payer liability exists.
The hospital must provide information about patient rights in the preferred language.
Appeals must be filed in writing within 30 days of the hospital's decision.
rule_charity_full may leave out a condition: requires sufficient supporting documentation
rule_uninsured_discount may leave out a condition: excludes elective cosmetic procedures and facility designated self-pay flat rate procedures
